# Kode Etik Perilaku

Code of Conduct

Kode Etik Perilaku Karyawan (Code of Conduct) merupakan panduan bagi PermataBankers dalam berinteraksi dengan pemangku kepentingan tentang cara bersikap dan bertingkah laku yang sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip moral atau nilai-nilai mengenai hal yang dianggap baik dan tidak baik, serta hal-hal yang benar dan yang tidak benar.

PermataBank mengharuskan PermataBankers untuk selalu bersikap hati-hati, cermat dan cerdas saat menghadapi hal-hal yang berpotensi menimbulkan risiko yang dapat merugikan perusahaan atau memiliki Risk Awareness. Dengan penerapan Kode Etik dan risk awareness yang tinggi, kesalahan dalam pengambilan keputusan dapat dihindari dan mencegah kerugian bagi perusahaan, maupun berimplikasi pada reputasi, integritas dan kehormatan karyawan itu sendiri.

Kode Etik dan Budaya Kepatuhan diperkenalkan kepada setiap PermataBankers dan wajib ditandatangani sejak pertama kali karyawan bergabung. Selama bekerja, sosialisasi dan pelatihan melalui e-learning terkait Kode Etik dan Budaya Kepatuhan, dan prosedur anti korupsi dilakukan secara berkala. PermataBankers juga diwajibkan melakukan penyegaran Kode Etik melalui e-learning setiap tahun.

Dari waktu ke waktu, PermataBank mengevaluasi Kode Etik Perilaku Karyawan serta melakukan monitoring atas pemenuhan pelaksanaan e-learning. Hasil pemantauan dan evaluasi dilaporkan kepada Direktur Kepatuhan serta melalui Laporan Profil Risiko.

The Employee Code of Conduct is the guidelines for PermataBankers in interacting with the stakeholders on how to act and behave in accordance with the moral principles or values on matters that are considered good and bad, as well as matters that are right and not right.

PermataBank requires PermataBankers to always be careful, cautious, and smart when dealing with matters that have the potential to create risk that may be detrimental to the company or in other words to have risk awareness. With the implementation of the Code of Ethics and high risk awareness, mistakes in decision making can be avoided and prevent losses for the company, as well as implications to the reputation, integrity, and respect of the employees themselves.

The Code of Conduct and the Compliance Culture are introduced to each PermataBanker and shall be signed since the first time an employee joins. During their tenure, dissemination and training related to the Code of Conduct and Compliance Culture as well as anti corruption procedures are conducted periodically. PermataBankers are also required to have Code of Conduct refreshment through e-learning annually.

From time to time, PermataBank evaluates the Employee Code of Conduct and monitors the fulfillment of e-learning implementation. The monitoring and evaluation results are reported to the Compliance Director as well as through the Risk Profile Report.

# Manajemen Risiko Fraud

Fraud Risk Management

Risiko fraud merupakan salah satu tantangan penting dalam integritas bisnis, terutama dalam menyediakan produk dan layanan keuangan. Terjadinya fraud mengakibatkan dampak merugikan bagi nasabah, kerugian, mempengaruhi reputasi dan melukai kepercayaan yang telah dibangun PermataBank. [GRI 103-1]

PermataBank telah menerapkan Fraud Risk Management Framework (FRMF) yang meliputi aktivitas pencegahan, pendeteksian, pemberian respons dan efek jera tersebut ke dalam strategi yang lengkap untuk mengelola risiko fraud di PermataBank. FRMF dikelola unit kerja Fraud Risk Management (FRM) di bawah koordinasi Direktorat Hukum dan Kepatuhan. [GRI 103-2]

Dalam penerapan kebijakan FRMF, PermataBank melaksanakan Fraud Risk Assessment (FRA), yang merupakan salah satu komponen utama pengelolaan risiko fraud, pada unit/produk/proses/aktivitas tertentu yang memiliki risiko fraud yang cukup tinggi, baik yang terpantau dari kenaikan insiden fraud maupun penambahan volume yang signifikan. Tujuan FRA adalah memperoleh kajian berkelanjutan untuk dapat mengetahui keefektifan pencegahan, pendeteksian dan respons terhadap setiap potensi skema dan kejadian fraud. [GRI 103-3]

Fraud risk is one of the most important challenges in business integration, particularly in providing financial products and services. The occurrence of fraud has resulted in adverse impacts for our customers including losses, affecting our reputation and hurting the trust that PermataBank has built. [GRI 103-1]

PermataBank has implemented the Fraud Risk Management Framework (FRMF) that includes prevention, detection, response, and deterrent effect into a comprehensive strategy designed to manage Fraud Risk at PermataBank. FRMF is managed by the Fraud Risk Management (FRM) unit under the coordination of the Legal and Compliance Directorate. [GRI 103-2]

In the implementation of the FRMF policy, PermataBank implements the Fraud Risk Assessment (FRA), which is one of the main components of fraud risk management on particular units/products/processes/activities with a high risk of fraud, monitored to have both an increasing number of fraud incidents or significant increase in volume. The objective of the FRA is to acquire a continuous study in order to determine the effectiveness of prevention, detection, and response to any potential fraud schemes and occurrences. [GRI 103-3]

# Upaya Pencegahan Fraud Internal

Internal Fraud Prevention Effort

Strategi dan kebijakan dalam mencegah dan memitigasi fraud selama tahun 2018 sebagai berikut:

1. Menerbitkan Kebijakan Benturan Kepentingan.
2. Melakukan tinjauan terhadap Kebijakan Pemberian Hadiah dan Jamuan.
3. Melakukan sosialisasi/refreshment perihal Kode Etik Perilaku Karyawan, Kebijakan Benturan Kepentingan, Kebijakan Pemberian Hadiah dan Jamuan, serta Kebijakan dan Prosedur Speak-Up.
4. Memberikan dukungan atas permintaan nasihat terkait Kode Etik dan Pemberian Hadiah dan Jamuan dari seluruh unit di PermataBank.
5. Melakukan monitoring atas pemenuhan pelaksanaan e-learning, yang selanjutnya dilaporkan melalui laporan Direktur Kepatuhan dan Laporan Profil Risiko.

Salah satu tantangan yang dihadapi PermataBank dalam melakukan upaya pencegahan fraud internal adalah jumlah PermataBankers yang perlu mendapatkan sosialisasi serta penyegaran yang berkesinambungan berkaitan dengan pencegahan dan mitigasi anti-fraud. [GRI 103-2]

## Pelatihan

Mengelola program e-learning, yakni model pelatihan/pembelajaran fraud awareness yang dikemas dalam bentuk animasi komputer disertai soal-soal pertanyaan, yang wajib diikuti oleh seluruh PermataBankers serta menyelenggarakan pelatihan pengenalan fraud bagi karyawan baru yang merupakan bagian dari New Employee Orientation Program (NEOP). Selain melalui e-learning, pelatihan tersebut juga dilakukan melalui tatap muka dengan PermataBankers.

## Blokir Rekening

Kebijakan blokir internal rekening giro dan tabungan nasabah terindikasi fraud untuk mencegah penggunaan rekening untuk menampung hasil kejahatan.

Strategy and policy in preventing and mitigating fraud in 2018 as follows:

1. Issuance of Conflict of Interest Policy.
2. Reviewed the provision of Gifts and Hospitality Policy.
3. Carried out socialization/refreshment on Code of Conduct, Conflict of Interest Policy, Provision of Gifts and Hospitality Policy, and Speak-Up Policy and Procedure.
4. Provided supports for advice request related to the Code of Conduct and Provision of Gifts and Hospitality Policy from all units at PermataBank.
5. Conducted monitoring on fulfillment of e-learning implementation, which is then reported through the Compliance Director's report and Risk Profile Report.

One of the challenges in preventing internal fraud is the total PermataBankers that required to have continuously socialization and refreshment related with anti-fraud prevention and mitigation. [GRI 103-2]

## Training

Managing the e-learning program, which is the fraud awareness training/learning model that is in the form of computer animation accompanied by questions, which must be followed by all PermataBankers as well as conducting the fraud recognition training for new employees (induction training) as part of New Employee Orientation Program (NEOP). Other than through e-learning, the training is also conducted through face-to-face with PermataBankers.

## Blocking Policy

The internal blocking policy of customers' checking and savings accounts that have indicated fraud in order to prevent the use of the accounts to collect any proceeds of crime.

# Speak Up

Speak Up

Speak Up adalah mekanisme Whistleblowing System yang diterapkan PermataBank sejak tahun 2008 untuk melaporkan indikasi pelanggaran Kode Etik Perilaku Karyawan maupun fraud termasuk kecurigaan atas tindakan pelanggaran yang berlaku di seluruh PermataBank (bank-wide). Setiap pelaporan/pengaduan melalui Speak-Up dicatat dalam register dan diklasifikasikan oleh Administrator, masing-masing dalam laporan terkait dengan dugaan fraud, pelanggaran ketentuan (kode etik), dan laporan umum lain seperti keluh kesah atau saran/masukan.

Setiap PermataBankers memiliki hak dan tanggung jawab untuk melaporkan setiap indikasi pelanggaran dan diwajibkan menyampaikan sesegera mungkin adanya tindakan pelanggaran yang dilakukan oleh karyawan lain kepada manajemen PermataBank melalui saluran Speak-Up yang telah disediakan. [GRI 102-17]

Speak Up is a Whistleblowing System mechanism that has been implemented by PermataBank since 2008 to report any indication of Employee Code of Conduct violations or fraud, including suspicion of violations applicable throughout PermataBank (bank-wide). Every report/complaints through Speak-Up are registered and classified by Administrator, each in a report related to alleged fraud, code of ethic violation, and other general report such as grievance or inputs/suggestions.

Every PermataBanker has the right and responsibility to report any indication of violation and is required to report the violation committed by other employee to the management of PermataBank through the provided Speak-Up channel as soon as possible. [GRI 102-17]

![img-137.jpeg](img-137.jpeg)

Selama tahun 2018, Administrator Speak-Up menerima 31 laporan, dengan 16 laporan berindikasi pelanggaran ketentuan Kode Etik. Seluruh tindak lanjut dilaporkan ke Speak-Up Council pada Speak-Up Council Meeting.

Throughout 2018, the Speak-Up Administrator received 31 reports, with 16 reports of violations of the Code of Conduct. All follow-ups are reported to the Speak-Up Council at the Speak-Up Council Meeting.

# Tata Kelola Pemasok Barang dan Jasa

Governance of Goods and Services Suppliers

PermataBank memanfaatkan produk dan jasa dari vendor pemasok, termasuk di antaranya untuk keperluan barang dan jasa perkantor, teknologi informasi, konstruksi, serta berbagai jasa untuk keperluan penjualan, kebersihan, transportasi maupun di bidang teknologi informasi, serta penyedia jasa konsultasi (seperti konsultan hukum, notaris, appraisal, dan lain-lain). [GRI 102-9]

Sebagai bagian dari penerapan GCG yang mengutamakan transparansi dan akuntabilitas, PermataBank menerapkan Kebijakan Pengadaan dan Pengelolaan Vendor (Procurement and Vendor Management Policy) yang meliputi kebijakan yang berkaitan dengan pengelolaan vendor dalam kegiatan rutin untuk memastikan kinerja vendor sesuai dengan perjanjian dan Service Level Agreement (SLA) yang telah disepakati.

Dalam melakukan pengadaan barang dan jasa, sangat penting untuk menjaga kode etik untuk tidak memberikan gratifikasi agar tidak terjadi kecurangan dan menjaga keadilan kompetisi antar vendor. Kode etik PermataBank menjelaskan bahwa dalam melakukan proses pengadaan harus menghindari segala bentuk benturan kepentingan. Salah satunya adalah menolak dan tidak meminta bantuan, komisi, hadiah, jamuan, perjalanan, atau bentuk imbalan lainnya dari pemasok sesuai dengan Kebijakan Pemberian Hadiah dan Jamuan yang berlaku. Dan jika terdapat hubungan kekerabatan antara pihak vendor dan PermataBank, maka vendor perlu memberikan pernyataan kepada PermataBank.

Selain itu, untuk mencegah potensi kecurangannya vendor, proses penilaian dalam masa pengadaan harus diikuti dan disetujui oleh PVM dan user terkait. Seluruh penjelasan terkait proses pengadaan dituangkan dalam dokumen Summary of Award (SOA) pada sistem PVMS dan disetujui oleh pejabat berwenang.

PermataBank uses the products and services of various supplier vendors, including among others for the needs of office goods and services, information technology, construction, as well as various services for sales, hygiene, transportation, and information technology, as well as service providers for consultation (including legal consultant, notary, appraisal, and others). [GRI 102-9]

As part of our GCG implementation that prioritizes transparency and accountability, PermataBank implements the Procurement and Vendor Management Policy that covers the policies relating to vendor management in routine activities to ensure the vendors' performance is in accordance with the agreement and Service Level Agreement that has been signed off.

In conducting the procurement of goods and services, it is very important to adhere to the Code of Conduct and to not provide any gratuity in order to avoid fraud and maintain fairness of competition among vendors. The Code of Conduct of PermataBank stipulates that all procurement processes shall avoid any forms of conflicts of interest. One of which is to refuse and not requesting assistance, commission, gifts, hospitality, travel, or other forms of rewards from suppliers in accordance with the prevailing provision of Gifts and Hospitality Policy. In the event of family relationships between the vendor and PermataBank, the vendor shall submit a statement to PermataBank.

In addition, to prevent fraud potential by vendors, the assessment process during the procurement period must be followed and approved by the related PVM and user. All explanations relating to the procurement process are set out in the Summary of Award (SOA) documents in the PVMS system and approved by the authorized officer.

Sesuai dengan Kebijakan Pengadaan, beberapa ketentuan pengelolaan vendor di PermataBank antara lain adalah:

a. Pengadaan barang dan jasa dengan nilai di atas Rp 100 juta harus dilakukan melalui unit Procurement Vendor Management (PVM) sesuai dengan kriteria dalam prosedur.

b. Proses pengadaan terdiri dari tahap identifikasi kebutuhan dan sumber pengadaan, tahap persiapan untuk sukses yang di dalamnya termasuk pembuatan rencana pengadaan dan strategi, tahap proses tender dan pembuatan keputusan, serta tahap penyelesaian dan serah terima pengelolaan.

c. Pengadaan dilakukan bersama antara User dan unit PVM. Untuk pengadaan di atas Rp 100 juta, permohonan pengadaan diajukan oleh User kepada PVM melalui sistem Procurement Vendor Management System (PVMS) dan selanjutnya diproses oleh PVM.

d. Dalam melakukan pengadaan, dilakukan proses due diligence atas vendor yang termasuk melakukan pemeriksaan dokumen legal vendor, kunjungan ke vendor dan analisa kondisi keuangan vendor sesuai kebutuhan.

e. Scoring dilakukan bersama-sama dengan pihak User dan PVM dengan cakupan penilaian:

1. Harga yang kompetitif.
2. Keahlian dan pengalaman termasuk sertifikasi teknis dari kontraktor.
3. Kemampuan dalam kecukupan finansial, rencana dan penanggulangan bencana (contingency plan).
4. Kesesuaian/kepatuhan terhadap spesifikasi dan kebutuhan PermataBank.
5. Kesesuaian dengan Kesehatan dan Keselamatan Kerja.
6. Referensi atas klien atau pelanggan lain.
7. Riwayat kinerja atas layanan kepada PermataBank.
8. Hasil screening atas rekanan dengan menggunakan aplikasi Anti Money Laundering.

In accordance with the Procurement Policy, some of the vendor management provisions at PermataBank are, among others:

a. Procurement of goods and services with a value of over Rp 100 million shall be carried out through the Procurement Vendor Management (PVM) unit in accordance with the criteria in the procedures.

b. The procurement process consists of the identification of needs and source of procurement phase, the preparation for success phase that includes the preparation of procurement plan and strategy, the bidding process and decision-making phase, and the completion and management hand-over phase.

c. The User and the PVM unit carry out the procurement together. For procurement with a value of over Rp 100 million, the procurement proposal is submitted by the User to the PVM through the Procurement Vendor Management System (PVMS) to be further processed by the PVM.

d. In the implementation of procurement, a due diligence process is conducted on the vendors, including examination of the vendor's legal documents, visit to the vendors, and analysis on the vendors' financial conditions as needed.

e. Scoring is carried out by the User and PVM parties with the following assessment scope:

1. Competitive price.
2. Expertise and experience, including technical certification of contractors.
3. Ability in financial adequacy, disaster planning and mitigation (contingency plan).
4. Suitability/compliance to the PermataBank's specifications and requirements.
5. Suitability to Occupational Health and Safety.
6. References from other clients and customers.
7. Performance history of services to PermataBank.
8. Screening results on partners using of the Anti-Money Laundering application.
